caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of geometric and stylized shapes in muted red, gold, and blue colors. At the top center is a gold cross outlined in red, with blue interior detailing and small gold radiating lines around its base. Beneath the cross is a bow-shaped element consisting of four loops and a central circle, all outlined in blue, filled with gold and red, and detailed with small blue and red dots. On either side of this bow shape are wing-like forms in solid gold with partial red at the tips. Below this central section is a large, circular medallion. The medallion has a repeating radial pattern that includes alternating petal and flame shapes in gold and red, surrounded by a blue outline and encircled by two rings — one blue and one red. The background is off-white with a slightly textured, aged appearance, and there are small black smudges in the bottom left and right corners.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
